title: 第4 章 送早饭
novel_title: 六零：冲喜？退伍糙汉夜夜疯！(豌豆饼干)
content_zh: 都挨了一顿骂，一个个的也都消停了。而葛美玲虽然没吃啥亏，但也满脸不忿，恨恨的瞪了张明霞和沈宝林一眼，一个咕噜翻身起来，拧哒拧哒就进了屋。而一直没啥动静的二房，胡慧芬叹了口气，一边穿衣服下炕一边儿跟自已的男人说：“大嫂也真是，向南都这样了，她还闹腾不休，当初当兵的名额本来就是人家老三用一条腿换回来的，她中间想要横插一杠子。后来见事儿不成，还逼着让老三把向南寄回来的津贴全都上交.......不过也是，老三家现在能挣工分的就弟妹和向北，这钱要是不拿出来，大嫂还指不定要闹成什么样儿呢！”沈宝树阴郁着脸嫌弃的瞪着胡慧芬。“你还好意思管别人，有那功夫管管你的肚子吧，我可告诉你，这次你要是再不给我生个带把的出来，你看我怎么收拾你！”胡慧芬脸一僵，瑟缩的摸着还没鼓起来的肚子往后退了退。她跟嫁给沈宝树二十年了，怀了七八次孕，连生了五个孩子，可最后只留下了三个丫头。因为这个，村子里的人都笑话她是不下蛋的母鸡，说沈家二房是个绝户头。沈宝树一不高兴就回来打她。就连她娘家也嫌弃她没用，就知道生赔钱货，害的她妹妹都没人要。可她也不想的，她也想有个儿子，做梦都想！.........外面的热闹，顾岁岁没有出去凑，但那么大的声音，该听的她也都听到了。倒是对沈家有了一个初步的了解，看来，除了沈向南的爹娘和亲兄弟，其他人对痴傻的原主也是怨言多多。不过她目前没什么依仗，没有家，也没有住的地方。关键是这个时代似乎对身份户籍卡的很严，想要走远一点儿的地方都要有根有据的开什么介绍信，像她这样一个单身女人根本无法正常生活。所以，她还是决定暂时留在沈家先看看情况再做打算，毕竟顾家比沈家也好不到哪去！但是，她要想把日子过舒坦了，似乎得先保证她的冲喜对象别出事。对象一死，她就成了沈家的寡妇.......要是能尽快分家就好了！不多时，外面彻底天亮了，门外响起了小心的敲门声。随即张明霞推门而入，一个昏迷着的，一个从小就没开过口的，她也不指望能有人给她个回应。一进门，张明霞就看到了坐在炕里面的顾岁岁。“岁岁，你这么早就醒了.......衣服都穿上了？过来娘看看扣子有没有扣好。”一边说着，她把碗放到炕边上，然后凑到儿子跟前小心的试探着他的呼吸，感受到手指处的气流，张明霞悄悄松了口气。然后又小声的叫了两声，见儿子仍然没有任何反应，她有些失望的拽了拽儿子身上的薄被子。“儿子，你都睡了这么长时间了，差不多的也该醒了......你看娘昨天都帮你把媳妇儿娶回来了，她叫顾岁岁，今年十七岁，虽然脑子有些不大清醒，但人老实。爹娘年纪大了，也管不了你们那么长时间，你自已的媳妇儿还是要你自已起来照顾啊......”张明霞一边絮叨一边转头看向一动不动的顾岁岁。娶这个媳妇儿回来之前他们也都去打听过，听张家庄的村里人说，这孩子虽然痴痴呆呆的什么都不知道，但基本穿衣服吃饭都能自已处理得了，就是你要提醒她去做，然后把饭放到她的手里。你要是不给她饭，她也不知道要，听说她小的时候有一次顾家人把她忘了，她差点儿饿死。至于平时的话，她也确实什么都干不了，连摘菜都摘不了，只会呆呆的坐在一个地方一动不动，你打她骂她她都像是个木头人，没有任何反应。有些人说，按照老话讲，顾岁岁天生这样，应该是出生的时候就少了一个魂，这魂不回来这辈子都好不了，什么时候这魂回来了，她也就正常了。张明霞叹了口气，她当初也不乐意找个这样的，本来儿子就需要人照顾，找个好的还能伺候儿子。可明知道这里是火坑，儿子活着当活寡妇，儿子死了当真寡妇，真疼姑娘的谁家也不愿意让孩子嫁进来。也有那有心想要拿姑娘换彩礼的，不过都狮子大开口，张嘴就是一百斤粮食。他们家本来就没啥底子，年吃年用，根本存不下什么东西。更何况现在这青黄不接的时候，一下子拿出一百斤的粮食，别说他们家，换谁家谁家也拿不出来。就是有，爹娘也不会愿意的。甚至连这二十斤还是他们求爹好不容易求出来的。最后只能去找顾家，毕竟这事儿也有顾家的责任。而顾家那头........想到顾家那些人的嘴脸，张明霞摇了摇头。反正商量来商量去，最后两家人决定用二十斤的粮食，把顾岁岁给换了回来。最关键的是，她偷偷去找了村东头的白胖子，他以前是给人看事儿的。她偷摸给了一斤地瓜，白胖子才说，顾岁岁的八字跟儿子合，大凶对大凶，有逢凶化吉之效，是最合适的冲喜人选，所以当时她才拍板定下来的。看着直愣愣望着她的顾岁岁，虽然是不得已的情况把人给娶回来了，但以后也就是他们家的人了。想到以前这姑娘过的那日子，张明霞声音温柔了很多。“岁岁，你别怕，我是娘，以后只要你乖乖听话，娘就给你送饭吃，快来，娘给你盛了一碗粥，还特意给你捞了稠的。”
content_en: They all received a scolding and all of them stopped.Although Ge Meiling did not suffer any loss, her face was full of dissatisfaction. She glared at Zhang Mingxia and Shen Baolin hatefully, stood up, twisted and entered the house.Hu Huifen, the second roommate who had been silent all this time, sighed and said to her husband while getting dressed and getting off the bed: "Sister-in-law, it's true, Xiangnan is like this. She is still making trouble. The number of soldiers was originally given by the third brother in exchange for one leg, and she wanted to get in the way. Later.Seeing that things were not going well, they forced the third child to hand over all the allowances sent back to Xiang Nan... But the only ones who can earn work points in the third family are his younger siblings and Xiang Bei.If the money is not paid, the sister-in-law may not know what kind of trouble will happen!" Shen Baoshu stared at Hu Huifen with a gloomy face and disgust."You still have the nerve to care about others. If you have the time to care about your belly, let me tell you, if you don't give me a baby this time, you see how I will deal with you!" Hu Huifen's face froze, and she shrank back while touching her belly that had not yet swollen.She had been married to Shen Baoshu for twenty years, became pregnant seven or eight times, and gave birth to five children in a row, but in the end she only had three girls left.Because of this, people in the village laughed at her as a hen that couldn't lay eggs, and said that the second wife of the Shen family was a destitute person.Shen Baoshu came back and beat her whenever he was unhappy.Even her mother-in-law despised her for being useless, knowing that she was a loser and her sister was no longer wanted.But she doesn’t want to, she also wants to have a son, even in her dreams!......... Gu Suisui didn't go out to join in the excitement outside, but she heard all the loud noises.But I have a preliminary understanding of the Shen family. It seems that except for Shen Xiangnan's parents and brothers, others also have a lot of complaints against the stupid original owner.But she currently has nothing to rely on, no home, and no place to live.The key is that this era seems to be very strict about identity and household registration cards. If you want to go further, you have to issue a well-founded letter of introduction. A single woman like her cannot live a normal life at all.Therefore, she decided to stay in the Shen family temporarily to see the situation before making any plans. After all, the Gu family was not much better than the Shen family!However, if she wants to live a comfortable life, it seems she must first ensure that nothing happens to her romantic partner.As soon as her partner died, she became the widow of the Shen family... It would be great if the family could be separated as soon as possible!Not long after, it was completely dawn outside, and there was a cautious knock on the door.Then Zhang Mingxia pushed the door open and walked in. A man was unconscious and a man who had not spoken since he was a child. She did not expect anyone to give her a response.As soon as she entered the door, Zhang Mingxia saw Gu Suisui sitting on the kang."Sui Sui, you woke up so early...Have you put on your clothes? Come here, mother, and see if the buttons are fastened." As she said this, she put the bowl on the edge of the kang, then came close to her son and carefully tested his breathing. Feeling the airflow between her fingers, Zhang Mingxia breathed a sigh of relief.Then she called softly twice more. Seeing that her son still didn't respond, she tugged on the thin quilt on her son's body with some disappointment."Son, you've been sleeping for such a long time, and it's almost time to wake up... You see, my mother helped you get your daughter-in-law back yesterday. Her name is Gu Suisui. She is seventeen years old this year. Although she is not very clear-headed, she is honest. My parents are old and can't take care of you for such a long time. You still need to get up and take care of your own daughter-in-law..." Zhang Mingxia babbled and turned to look at Gu Suisui, who was motionless.They also went to inquire about this daughter-in-law before she came back. They heard from the villagers in Zhangjiazhuang that although this child was so demented that she didn't know anything, she could basically dress and eat by herself. You just had to remind her to do it and then put the food in her hands.If you don't give her food, she won't know how to ask for it. I heard that when she was a child, her family members forgot about her and she almost starved to death.As for normal times, it is true that she can't do anything, not even pick vegetables. She will just sit in one place motionless. Even if you hit her and scold her, she will act like a wooden person without any reaction.Some people say that according to the old saying, Gu Suisui was born like this. She should have lost a soul when she was born. If this soul does not come back, she will never get better in her life. When the soul comes back, she will be normal.Zhang Mingxia sighed. She was not happy to find someone like this at the beginning. Her son originally needed someone to take care of her, so she could find a good one who could take care of her son.But knowing that this place is a fire pit, the son will be treated as a living widow when he is alive, and the son will be treated as a real widow after his death. No family who really loves the girl is willing to let their child marry in.There are also those who want to exchange girls for betrothal gifts, but they all open their mouths and get a hundred catties of grain.Their family had little foundation to begin with. They had to eat every year and could not save anything at all.What's more, during this lean period, if you take out a hundred kilograms of grain at once, no one else, let alone theirs, can get it.Even if there were, my parents wouldn't be willing to do it.Even these twenty kilograms were obtained through hard work from their father.In the end, he had no choice but to go to the Gu family. After all, the Gu family was also responsible for this matter.As for the Gu family... Thinking of the faces of the Gu family, Zhang Mingxia shook her head.Anyway, after much discussion, the two families finally decided to exchange twenty kilograms of grain for Gu Suisui.The most important thing is that she secretly went to find the fat man at the east end of the village. He used to look after people.She secretly gave him a pound of sweet potatoes, and Fatty Bai said that Gu Suisui's horoscope matched that of her son's, and that the bad luck could turn bad luck into good luck, so he was the most suitable candidate for the wedding. That's why she made the decision at that time.Looking at Gu Suisui, who was staring at her blankly, she realized that although she had to marry someone out of necessity, she would be a member of their family from now on.Thinking of the days this girl lived in the past, Zhang Mingxia's voice became much gentler."Sui Sui, don't be afraid. I am my mother. As long as you are obedient from now on, my mother will give you food to eat. Come on, my mother will serve you a bowl of porridge and even scoop out the thick porridge for you."
